description: This file defines a custom TorchDispatchMode subclass 'SchemaCheckMode' used for verifying operation schemas, recording called ops, mutations, and aliasing in PyTorch. It includes utility functions for tensor input cloning and iterable checks, and references multiple external PyTorch modules and internal C++ schema classes.

classes.name: Mutation
classes.description: NamedTuple representing an operation mutation with operation name and argument name.

classes.name: Aliasing
classes.description: NamedTuple representing an aliasing relationship between operation output and input.

classes.name: SchemaCheckMode
classes.description: A TorchDispatchMode subclass used to verify operation schemas, record called ops, mutations, and aliasing during tensor operations.

methods.name: is_iterable_of_tensors
methods.description: Checks if an iterable contains only torch.Tensor objects, excluding the tensor itself.

methods.name: clone_inputs
methods.description: Creates deep copies of tensor inputs and iterable of tensors, used for input cloning before operation dispatch.
